caption: The drawing depicts a metallic, box-shaped object on two curved legs, set against a plain beige background. The main body of the object is a trapezoidal structure colored in dark gray to black shades, with a rectangular compartment on top, raised above the main body by four support posts at each corner. On top of this compartment, there is a small circular dish or knob. The front of the main body has an angular door or hatch with a latch, and a flat, circular tray extends horizontally from the bottom front, supported by a third curved leg. The name "Lon Cronk" appears twice in small capital letters, handwritten below and near the object against the empty background.
title: Shaker Stove
